prep.name: CURE
prep.text: `Cure' heals one point of damage per       point of wizdom.

prep.name: SENSE LEVEL
prep.text: `Sense Level' determines which level you   are on.

battle.name: GAS
battle.text: When it works, `Gas' makes 1'st through    3'rd level creatures fall asleep,       allowing you to kill them.

battle.name: MAGIC ZOT
battle.text: `Magic Zot' does about 1 to 4 points of    damage per level of the caster to all   creatures.

prep.name: STRENGTH
prep.text: `Strength' increases strength. It lasts    until you return to the 0'th level.

prep.name: SPEED
prep.text: `Speed' increases agility. It lasts        until you return to the 0'th level.

battle.name: MAGIC BOLT
battle.text: `Magic Bolt' does about 20 or 30 point     of damage to all creatures.

battle.name: SPEED
battle.text: This `Speed' spell increases agility for   a short time.

prep.name: SENSE LOCATION
prep.text: `Sense Location' indicates your x,y        and level position in the dungeon.

prep.name: DESCEND
prep.text: `Descend' lowers you to the next level.

battle.name: LIGHTNING
battle.text: `Lighning Bolt' does 6 or 7 point of       damage per level of caster.

battle.name: STRENGTH
battle.text: This `Strength' increases strength for     a short time.

prep.name: ASCEND
prep.text: `Ascend' causes you to float up one        level.

battle.name: GO AWAY!
battle.text: `Go Away' sends the monster away,          leaving treasure with you. Won't        always work.

battle.name: RISE...
battle.text: `Rise' causes you to float up to the       next level, leaving the monster         behind.

prep.name: CHANGE LEVEL
prep.text: `Change Level' sends you to a random       chosen level.

prep.name: INVISIBILITY
prep.text: `Invisibility' makes it difficult for      monsters to see you, making it easier   to run away from them.

battle.name: AUTO KILL
battle.text: `Auto kill' makes monsters fall over       dead. Does not always work.

battle.name: EXPLOSION
battle.text: `Explosion' does lots of damage to         monsters if the caster is high level.

prep.name: MOCCIOLO
prep.text: `Mocciolo' is a last resort. It may kill   or save you.

battle.name: GOD?
battle.text: `God?' is a last resort. It may kill or     save you.

prepText: Teleport Scroll: Teleports caster to       0'th level.
Scroll of Seeing: Maps an entire level     of the dungeon.
Scroll of Healing: Increases health        points.
Spell Point Scroll: Increases spell        points.
Bag of Holding: Holds about 1000 pounds    of treasure and weighs nothing.
Floor Slosher: Lowers user to the next     deeper level.
Level Shifter: Moves user to a new         level.
battleText: Potion of Speed: Increases agility for     a short time,
Potion of Fire: Allows you to breath       fire on monsters.
Potion of Invincibility: Makes your        armor very strong.
Potion of Health Points: Heals wounds.
Potion of Relocation: Moves caster to a    random location on the same level.
Holy Hand Grenade: Blows up the            monster.
